description.value: The Grad House Restaurant is a pub and restaurant on the University of Victoria campus, owned and operated by the Graduate Students' Society. It offers sit-down dining, table reservations by email, and in-house catering for both public and private events. Cyclists exploring the UVic campus grounds will find it a convenient meal stop, with the venue welcoming all guests.

address.value: 3800 Finnerty Rd, Victoria, BC V8N 6K8, Canada

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 53m; rack (covered) at 66m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Grad House Restaurant is an active pub/restaurant on the UVic campus, owned and operated by the Graduate Students' Society, with menu, catering, and table reservations available. The phone number 250-721-8942 is confirmed on the contact page matching the OSM tag. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those fields default to null.
concerns: No street address in OSM record; website provides the GSS office address (Room 102 Halpern Centre, 3800 Finnerty Rd, Victoria, BC V8P 5C2) but does not give a distinct address for the Grad House building itself.
Venue is primarily oriented toward the graduate student community; public access for walk-in dining is not explicitly stated but not restricted either.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, publicly accessible restaurant and pub on the UVic campus with confirmed contact details and regular dining service; a useful stop for cyclists in the university area.
